Signup

Email Email is required Invalid email format Password Password is required Min 6 characters Confirm Password Confirmation is required Role User Admin Role is required

Already have an account? Login

import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { AuthService } from 'src/app/services/auth.service'; @Component({ selector: 'app-signup', templateUrl: './signup.component.html', }) export class SignupComponent { userData = { name: '', email: '', password: '', role: 'USER', // default }; constructor(private authService: AuthService) {} onSignup() { this.authService.signup(this.userData).subscribe({ next: (res) => console.log('Signup Success', res), error: (err) => console.error('Signup Error', err), }); } }
